requirement.requirement_text: 每日或手动触发。所有输入（语录、语气、情绪、风格、音色标识）存放在 Google Sheets 中，每次运行只处理一条尚未发布的语录行，以避免重复发布或遗漏。处理过程为：将这条语录转换为一段 8 秒的竖版（1080x1920）电影感短视频；由语言模型撰写分镜脚本，并生成适用于 TikTok、Instagram Reels 与 YouTube Shorts 的文案；为语录生成配音，并生成配乐与视觉画面；渲染出视频后，将配音、视频与文字合成在一起，并对成片做画质提升；随后通过发布服务将视频直接发布到 TikTok、Instagram Reels 与 YouTube Shorts；最后在 Google Sheets 中将该条语录标记为已发布。

source_spans.text:
Transform a single quote into a fully-rendered cinematic short video — with voice-over, visuals, and music — then publish it directly to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.  
This isn’t just automation. It’s a full-stack AI video content engine built entirely in n8n.

Converts any quote into an 8-second cinematic video (vertical, 1080x1920)
Adds AI-generated voice-over, music, and visuals
Generates viral-ready captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts
Publishes automatically via Postiz API
Pulls content from Google Sheets — updates status after posting (no duplicates)

Triggers daily or manually
Fetches one unposted quote row from Google Sheets
Uses Google Gemini + GPT to write scene + captions
Converts quote to voice with ElevenLabs
Renders video via Google VEO3
Merges audio + video + text in Creatomate
Upscales the final video via Cloudinary
Publishes directly to all 3 platforms via Postiz
Marks the quote as “Posted” in the sheet ✅

All input (quote, tone, mood, style, voice ID) is stored in a Google Sheet.  
The workflow processes one new row per run — no duplicates, no missed posts.

inputs: 存放在 Google Sheets 中的语录行（语录、语气、情绪、风格、音色标识）
conditions: 每次运行只处理一条尚未发布的语录行，避免重复与遗漏
allowed_actions: 将语录渲染为 8 秒的竖版（1080x1920）视频
使用语言模型撰写分镜脚本与三平台的发布文案
为语录生成配音，并生成配乐与视觉画面
将配音、视频与文字合成为成片
将视频发布到 TikTok、Instagram Reels 与 YouTube Shorts
在 Google Sheets 中将该语录标记为已发布
visible_outcomes: TikTok、Instagram Reels 与 YouTube Shorts 上发布的竖版短视频
Google Sheets 中该条语录被标记为已发布
